sentences.text: This ancient fish belongs to the class Chondrichthyes, a group of cartilaginous fishes.
It is a member of the family Deltoptychiidae.
Its massive eyes were specialized for hunting in the deep ocean.
Scientists first named the genus Deltoptychius in 1862.
Remains were found within the Glencartholm Volcanic Beds Formation in Scotland.
The species Cochliodus acutus serves as the type species for this genus.
These creatures inhabited waters that are now part of the United Kingdom.
They lived between 346.7 and 298.9 million years ago.
